title: All ten baseline TABLES typed callback retention bounds
head: de27a3391a624aba03ca71f3583c4b3a6e6396a9
scope: Bound adapter-owned APPID, BLOCK_RECORD, DIMSTYLE, LAYER, LTYPE, LAYOUT, VIEW, UCS, VPORT, and STYLE callback copies over the dx_data container lifetime

Account for common table-entry members and all callback-owned dynamic payloads, including private LTYPE parser-vector and BLOCK_RECORD entity-map slots plus DIMSTYLE map nodes, keys, variants, text and binary values
Respect existing DRW_UCS::kMaxOrthographicOptions and DRW_Layout::kMaxViewportCount parser-side per-record ceilings
Make partial or over-budget capture fail closed before DXF output publication
Add generated fast coverage for exact admission, over-budget rejection, sticky failure, copy independence, and destination preservation

controls: All ten callback families share one aggregate record/item/byte budget
Exact-fit aggregate record, item, and byte limits admit generated callback values
Record, dynamic-item, and byte over-budget attempts refuse copies and leave counters unchanged
A UCS value exceeding DRW_UCS::kMaxOrthographicOptions is rejected before its copy is retained
A LAYOUT value exceeding DRW_Layout::kMaxViewportCount is rejected before its copy is retained
DIMSTYLE string, numeric, and binary variants are accounted and remain deep-copy independent
BLOCK_RECORD preview bytes, INSERT handles, and private entity-map slots are accounted
Capture failure is sticky and DXF export refuses before replacing an existing destination
implementation.limitations: This closes only the direct baseline TABLES typed callback-store census. It bounds adapter-owned copies, not parser grammar, serializers, semantics, consumer behavior, or the broader 7S.2c TABLES/OBJECTS callback census.

localEvidence: The callback-store audit enumerated all ten direct baseline TABLES typed destinations; the final slice accounts DIMSTYLE and BLOCK_RECORD in addition to the prior eight families.
DIMSTYLE charges its nine owned strings, map slots and keys, DRW_Variant objects, string payloads with a conservative duplicate for possible DWG layer-reference spelling, and binary payload bytes.
BLOCK_RECORD charges xrefPath, description, preview bytes, INSERT handle slots, and private entity-map slots; other callback families retain the previously recorded dynamic-member accounting.
The generated regression uses in-memory C++ values and a temporary output sentinel; no persistent or downloaded drawing fixture was added.
